remarks: Beautifully maintained raised ranch featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths. Enjoy a remodeled kitchen and updated bathrooms, along with a newer roof and siding offering peace of mind. The home boasts a finished basement with a classic old-fashioned bar-perfect for entertaining or relaxing evenings. Step out to the enclosed porch or the expansive deck overlooking a fenced, level yard, great for gatherings, pets, or play. Add a shed for additional storage. Situated on a level lot in a prime location with easy access to major highways, railroad stations, shopping, and restaurants. Move-in ready and full of charm! Waiting for your personal finishing touches!
